assumptions: Sagittal plane only; both legs move identically and each carries half of the HAT (bilateral symmetry, D-022)

Foot fixed flat on the ground: the heel ground point is the Gait2392 calcaneus origin and the ground passes through it; the support runs from that heel point to the MTP joint (toes excluded, a conservative choice)
Ankle, knee and hip are revolute joints with fixed centres; the Gait2392 knee translation is frozen at knee angle zero
HAT = Gait2392 pelvis + torso with the low-back joint locked; for the de Leva bodies its mass comes from de Leva and its shape (centre of mass, radius of gyration) is scaled from Gait2392 by stature
de Leva bodies: Gait2392 joint positions and foot points scaled by stature / 1.8 m (documented Gait2392 stature)
de Leva radius of gyration: the 'transverse' column is taken as the radius for rotation in the sagittal plane (interpretation, D-058 Amendment 2)
Motion prescribed; inverse dynamics returns the net joint torques needed. No muscles (Stage D2)

omitted_physics.contact: Idealized rigid foot fixed to the ground; ground force and centre of pressure are computed, not modeled; heel lift and sliding are flagged, not simulated
omitted_physics.muscles: Omitted: net joint torques only; no muscle forces, activation or co-contraction (Stage D2)
omitted_physics.passive_structures: Omitted: ligaments, joint capsules and passive joint limits
omitted_physics.spine: Omitted: spinal motion; pelvis and torso move as one body
omitted_physics.three_dimensional: Omitted: frontal and transverse plane motion, knee rotation and translation, foot joints

depth_angles.rationale: Ankle dorsiflexion 40 deg, knee flexion 100 deg, hip flexion 74 deg at the bottom. Chosen by a search so that the centre of pressure stays at least 24 mm inside the heel-to-ball support for all three bodies throughout; NOT taken from measured squats (real squats also move the pelvis and spine, and lift the heel when needed)

friction_coefficient.rationale: Threshold for flagging samples that would need more grip; a round value for shoe on a dry floor, not measured. The maximum required ratio is reported whatever the threshold

gravity.rationale: Standard acceleration of gravity, a conventional value (BIPM SI Brochure); local gravity differs by up to about 0.3%

period.rationale: One squat, 1.5 s down and 1.5 s up; a moderate pace chosen for viewing, not measured

samples.rationale: Output every 10 ms over the 3 s squat; results are evaluated exactly at each sample, so this sets resolution, not accuracy

start_angles.rationale: Start and end standing in the Gait2392 default pose (ankle, knee, hip all zero)

conventions.coordinates: q = (ankle dorsiflexion, knee flexion, hip flexion), radians, zero in the Gait2392 default pose
conventions.frame: Gait2392 body frames: x anterior, y superior, z right; angles counter-clockwise about z
conventions.points: positions relative to the ankle centre, metres
conventions.torque: generalized force conjugate to each coordinate, per leg; positive acts to increase the coordinate

hat_drawing_note: hat_drawing_top = hip + 2 x HAT centre-of-mass vector: for drawing the upper body only, not a landmark

how_built: scale = stature / Gait2392 stature = 1.735 / 1.8 = 0.963889
segment mass = de Leva mass fraction x body mass
thigh: HJC->KJC vector = scale x Gait2392 knee location (length 0.38163 m); COM at de Leva fraction from the hip; I = m (radius fraction x length)^2
shank: KJC->AJC vector = scale x Gait2392 ankle location (length 0.41447 m); COM at de Leva fraction from the knee; I = m (radius fraction x length)^2
HAT mass = (head + trunk + 2 x (upper arm + forearm + hand)) fractions x body mass = 0.5823 x M
HAT centre of mass = scale x Gait2392 HAT centre of mass; HAT radius of gyration = scale x Gait2392 value (assumption: the de Leva bodies share Gait2392's HAT shape)
foot mass = de Leva foot fraction x body mass; foot points and centre of mass = scale x Gait2392 foot
per leg: half the HAT (bilateral symmetry)
